mapper.sql: pfcc.FIVE_CLASSIFY_CON_ID, pfcc.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_ID, pfcc.CONTRACT_ID, pfcc.CONTRACT_TYPE, pfcc.CONTRACT_BP_NAME, pfcc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, pfcc.CONTRACT_PRJ_NAME, pfcc.CONTRACT_BUSINESS_DEPARTMENT, pfcc.CONTRACT_AMOUNT, pfcc.CONTRACT_REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, pfcc.LAST_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, pfcc.FIRST_CLASSIFICATION_TIME, pfcc.FIRST_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, pfcc.FINAL_CLASSIFICATION_TIME, pfcc.FINAL_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, pfcc.IS_INTER_MANAGE_ABNORMAL, pfcc.IS_PRODUCTION_LINE_STOPPED, pfcc.IS_PRODUCT_STRUCTURE_CHANGE, pfcc.IS_MARKET_PRICE_LEASING, pfcc.IS_OTHER_CASES, pfcc.IS_MAJOR_PLAN, pfcc.IS_EXECUTIVE_PERSONNEL_CHANGE, pfcc.IS_EXTERNAL_ENVIRONMENT, pfcc.IS_MAJOR_PROCEEDINGS, pfcc.IS_MAJOR_PENALTY, pfcc.IS_MAJOR_ACCIDENTS, pfcc.IS_MAJOR_OTHER_CASES, pfcc.IS_VALUE_REDUCED, pfcc.GUARANTOR_FINANCIAL_STATUS, pfcc.OTHER_GUARANTEES_SITUATION, pfcc.OPERATING_PROFIT_STATUS, pfcc.REVENUE_COMPARISON_STATUS, pfcc.OPER_CF_CHANGE_STATUS, pfcc.NET_OPERATING_CASHFLOW_STATUS, pfcc.OTHER_FINANCIAL_SITUATION, pfcc.LEASE_RENT_SITUATION, pfcc.OTHER_INST_OVERDUE_SITUATION, pfcc.TWO_YEARS_LOSSES_STATUS, pfcc.CREDIT_FORMULA_SYSTEM_STATUS, pfcc.OTHER_CASES_SITUATION, pfcc.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER, pfcc.REQUEST_ID, pfcc.PROGRAM_ID, pfcc.CREATED_BY, pfcc.CREATION_DATE, pfcc.LAST_UPDATED_BY, pfcc.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, pfcc.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN, pfcc.CHANGE_IQ, pfcc.CHANGE_TIME, pfcc.APPROVAL_NODE, pfcc.CLASSIFICATION_REASON, pfcc.BUSINESS_TYPE, pfcc.APPROVAL_NUMBER
mapper.select:
SELECT PRO.* FROM ( SELECT fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, fp.BUSINESS_TYPE, HBM.BP_NAME contract_bp_name, HBM.BP_ID, FOU.UNIT_NAME contract_business_department, fp.company_id, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'FCT' as contract_type, fc.created_by FROM FCT_PROJECT fp JOIN FCT_PROJECT_BP fpb ON fp.project_id = fpb.project_id JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fpb.BP_ID JOIN FCT_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) AND fpb.credit_grantor_party='Y' AND fc.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PFCC.CONTRACT_ID FROM PLM_FIVE_CLASSIFY_CON PFCC WHERE PFCC.CONTRACT_TYPE='FCT' AND PFCC.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_ID=#{fiveClassificationId} )
UNION ALL
SELECT fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, fp.BUSINESS_TYPE, HBM.BP_NAME contract_bp_name, HBM.BP_ID, FOU.UNIT_NAME contract_business_department, fp.company_id, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'CON' as contract_type, fc.created_by FROM PRJ_PROJECT fp JOIN CON_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) AND fc.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PFCC.CONTRACT_ID FROM PLM_FIVE_CLASSIFY_CON PFCC WHERE PFCC.CONTRACT_TYPE='CON' AND PFCC.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_ID=#{fiveClassificationId} ) ) PRO
WHERE 1=1
AND PRO.contract_bp_name like concat(concat('%',#{contractBpName}),'%')
AND (PRO.CONTRACT_NUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%') OR PRO.APPROVAL_NUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%'))
ORDER BY PRO.CREATION_DATE DESC

SELECT cc.contract_id, 'CON' as contract_type, cc.contract_number, cc.quotation_id, fou.unit_name as contract_business_department, hbm.bp_name as contract_bp_name, prj.project_name as contract_prj_name, cc.BUSINESS_TYPE, pp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, MAX(cqc.FINE_DAYS) FINE_DAYS FROM con_contract cc LEFT JOIN con_quotation_cashflow cqc ON cc.CONTRACT_ID = cqc.CONTRACT_ID LEFT JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.project_id = pp.project_id, fnd_org_unit fou, hls_bp_master hbm, prj_project prj
cc.unit_id = fou.unit_id AND cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.project_id = prj.project_id
AND cc.contract_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, cc.quotation_id, fou.unit_name , hbm.bp_name, prj.project_name, cc.BUSINESS_TYPE, pp.APPROVAL_NUMBER

SELECT ff.contract_id,ff.project_id,ff.contract_type,fctp.contract_number, ff.contract_business_department,ff.contract_status, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, fctp.project_name AS contract_prj_name, ff.BUSINESS_TYPE, ff.APPROVAL_NUMBER, MAX(fqc.FINE_DAYS) FINE_DAYS FROM ( SELECT fct.contract_id, fct.project_id, 'FCT' AS contract_type, fct.contract_number, fou.unit_name AS contract_business_department, fct.contract_status, fct.BUSINESS_TYPE, fct.APPROVAL_NUMBER FROM fct_contract fct LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fct.unit_id = fou.unit_id WHERE fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' ) ff LEFT JOIN fct_quotation_cashflow fqc ON ff.CONTRACT_ID = fqc.CONTRACT_ID, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project fctp, fct_project_bp fpb
ff.project_id = fctp.project_id AND ff.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id
AND ff.contract_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY ff.contract_id,ff.project_id,ff.contract_type,fctp.contract_number, ff.contract_business_department,ff.contract_status, hbm.bp_name, fctp.project_name, ff.BUSINESS_TYPE, ff.APPROVAL_NUMBER

SELECT cc.contract_number, nvl(cc.finance_amount,0) as finance_amount, nvl(cqc.received_principal,0) as received_principal, (select sum(cq.lease_item_amount) from con_quotation cq where cq.source_document_id = cc.contract_id group by cq.source_document_id) as lease_item_amount FROM con_contract cc, con_contract_cashflow cqc
cc.contract_id = cqc.contract_id AND cc.company_id = #{companyId} AND cc.inception_of_lease IS NOT NULL AND ( cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' OR cc.contract_status = 'PENDING' ) and cqc.cf_item=1 AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL'
AND cc.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')

SELECT fall.*, nvl( ( SELECT sum( fqc.due_amount ) FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fall.contract_id = fqc.contract_id AND cf_item = 40 ), 0 ) AS finance_amount, nvl( ( SELECT sum( fqc.write_off_amount ) FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fall.contract_id = fqc.contract_id AND cf_item = 54 ), 0 ) AS received_principal FROM ( SELECT ff.contract_id, 'FCT' AS contract_type, ff.contract_number, ff.contract_business_department, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, fctp.project_name AS contract_prj_name, fctp.project_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT fct.contract_id, fct.contract_number, fct.company_id, fct.contract_name, fct.project_id, fct.unit_id, fou.unit_name AS contract_business_department FROM fct_contract fct LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_ln cprl ON fct.contract_id = cprl.source_doc_id LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd cprh ON cprl.payment_req_id = cprh.payment_req_id LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fct.unit_id = fou.unit_id WHERE cprh.payment_req_status = 'APPROVED' AND ( fct.contract_status = 'INCEPT' OR fct.contract_status = 'PENDING' ) AND fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fct.company_id = #{companyId} ) ff, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project fctp, fct_project_bp fpb, ( SELECT fct.project_id FROM fct_contract fct WHERE fct.contract_id = #{contractId} ) f WHERE ff.project_id = fctp.project_id AND ff.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND ff.project_id = f.project_id ) fall LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fct.contract_number, fct.contract_status, fct.data_class FROM fct_contract fct WHERE data_class = 'CHANGE_REQ' AND fct.company_id = #{companyId} ) fctt ON fall.contract_number = fctt.contract_number WHERE ( fctt.contract_status IS NULL OR fctt.contract_status = 'INCEPT' )
SELECT MAX(pfcc.change_time) AS change_time FROM plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = #{fiveClassificationId} GROUP BY pfcc.five_classification_id

SELECT cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name as contract_bp_name, cc.inspect_frenquency as contract_frequency FROM con_contract cc, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id AND cc.inception_of_lease IS NOT NULL AND ( cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' OR cc.contract_status = 'PENDING' ) AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.company_id = #{companyId} AND hbm.bp_id = #{contractBpId} UNION ALL SELECT ff.contract_number, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, fctp.post_loan_ins_frequency AS contract_frequency FROM ( SELECT fct.contract_id, fct.contract_number, fct.rate_valid_from, fct.company_id, fct.project_id FROM fct_contract fct LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_ln cprl ON fct.contract_id = cprl.source_doc_id LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd cprh ON cprl.payment_req_id = cprh.payment_req_id WHERE cprh.payment_req_status = 'APPROVED' AND fct.company_id = #{companyId} AND fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' ) ff, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project fctp, fct_project_bp fpb WHERE ff.project_id = fctp.project_id AND ff.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND hbm.bp_id = #{contractBpId}

SELECT allContracts.contract_bp_name, allContracts.bp_id, item_type, min(allContracts.inception_of_lease) AS inception_of_lease FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT cc.contract_id, 'CON' AS contract_type, cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, prj.project_name AS contract_prj_name, cc.inception_of_lease, hbm.bp_id, item.ITEM_TYPE item_type FROM con_contract cc inner join hls_bp_master hbm on cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id inner join prj_project prj on cc.project_id = prj.project_id LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT_LEASE_ITEM item on item.PROJECT_ID=cc.project_id WHERE cc.inception_of_lease IS NOT NULL AND cc.contract_status in ('INCEPT','PENDING') AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ff.contract_id, 'FCT' AS contract_type, ff.contract_number, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, fctp.project_name AS contract_prj_name, ff.rate_valid_from AS inception_of_lease, hbm.bp_id, '' AS item_type FROM ( SELECT fct.contract_id, fct.contract_number, fct.rate_valid_from, fct.company_id, fct.project_id FROM fct_contract fct WHERE fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fct.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' UNION ALL select c.contract_id, c.contract_number, c.rate_valid_from, c.company_id, c.project_id from fct_project a, change_req_info b,fct_contract c where a.data_type = 'CHANGE_REQ' and a.change_req_id = b.change_req_id and c.project_id = b.document_id and a. contract_status='INCEPT' and c.data_class = 'NORMAL' and b.document_id in (select fct.project_id from fct_contract fct where fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fct.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'PENDING') and ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT CC, CHANGE_REQ_INFO CRI WHERE CRI.CHANGE_REQ_ID=CC.CHANGE_REQ_ID AND CC.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' ) >0 ) ff, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project fctp, fct_project_bp fpb WHERE ff.project_id = fctp.project_id AND ff.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id ) allContracts GROUP BY allContracts.contract_bp_name, allContracts.bp_id, item_type

select distinct allContracts.* from( SELECT p.contract_number, p.contract_name, (SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master WHERE bp_id = p.tenant_id) AS contract_bp_name, (SELECT hdt.description FROM hls_document_type hdt WHERE hdt.business_type = p.business_type AND hdt.document_category = p.document_category AND hdt.document_type = p.document_type ) AS document_type_desc, p.project_name, p.contract_status FROM prj_project p
p.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND p.data_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.CONTRACT_STATUS!='TERMINATE'
UNION ALL SELECT fp.contract_number, fp.contract_name, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, ( SELECT DISTINCT hbt.description FROM hls_business_type hbt WHERE hbt.business_type = fp.business_type AND hbt.document_category = fp.document_category ) AS document_type_desc, fp.project_name, fp.contract_status FROM fct_project fp LEFT JOIN fct_project_bp fpb on fp.project_id = fpb.project_id LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = fpb.bp_id where fp.data_type = 'NORMAL' AND fp.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON'
AND hbm.bp_id = #{bpId} AND fp.CONTRACT_STATUS!='END' ) allContracts

SELECT PRO.* FROM ( SELECT fc.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON FPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE FPB.CREDIT_GRANTOR_PARTY='Y' AND FPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) BP_NAME, fpb.BP_ID, fc.RATE_VALID_FROM, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'FCT_CONTRACT' CONTRACT_TYPE, HDT.DESCRIPTION AS BUSINESS_TYPE, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON FPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE FPB.BP_ROLE_TYPE NOT IN('SELLER', 'BUYER') AND FPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) GUARANTOR_NAME FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP fpb LEFT JOIN FCT_PROJECT fp ON fp.project_id = fpb.project_id LEFT JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fpb.BP_ID LEFT JOIN FCT_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , SUM((case when cf.cf_item = 40 then nvl(cf.write_off_amount,0) else 0 end)) finance_amount, SUM((case when cf.cf_item = 54 then cf.due_amount-nvl(cf.write_off_amount,0) else 0 end)) remain_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID LEFT JOIN hls_business_type HDT on fc.BUSINESS_TYPE = HDT.BUSINESS_TYPE AND FC.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=HDT.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND fc.CONTRACT_STATUS != 'END' UNION ALL SELECT fc.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON PPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE PPB.BP_TYPE='TENANT' AND PPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) BP_NAME, HBM.BP_ID, fc.LEASE_START_DATE, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'CON_CONTRACT' CONTRACT_TYPE, HDT.DESCRIPTION as BUSINESS_TYPE, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON PPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE PPB.BP_TYPE NOT IN('TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC', 'VENDER') AND PPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) GUARANTOR_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PPB2 LEFT JOIN PRJ_PROJECT fp on PPB2.PROJECT_ID=fp.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = PPB2.BP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , SUM((case when cf.cf_item = 0 then nvl(cf.received_amount,0) else 0 end)) finance_amount, SUM((case when cf.cf_item = 1 then cf.principal-nvl(cf.received_principal,0) else 0 end)) remain_amount FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID LEFT JOIN HLS_BUSINESS_TYPE HDT on fc.BUSINESS_TYPE = HDT.BUSINESS_TYPE AND FC.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=HDT.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY
WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND fc.CONTRACT_STATUS != 'TERMINATE' ) PRO
WHERE 1=1 AND PRO.BP_ID=#{bpId}
ORDER BY PRO.CREATION_DATE DESC

SELECT cc.contract_number, cc.lease_start_date valid_from, cs.*, hci.description as cf_item_desc FROM (SELECT ccc.contract_id, ccc.times, ccc.cf_item, ccc.due_amount, ccc.due_date, ccc.received_amount, ccc.write_off_flag FROM ( SELECT ccc.times, ccc.contract_id FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc WHERE ccc.cf_item = 9 AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id ) cf, con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = cf.contract_id AND cf.times = ccc.times AND ccc.cf_item != 9) cs LEFT JOIN con_contract cc on cs.contract_id = cc.contract_id LEFT JOIN hls_cashflow_item hci ON cs.cf_item = hci.cf_item
cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.company_id = #{companyId} AND cc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT fct.contract_number, fct.valid_from, cs.*, hci.description as cf_item_desc FROM ( SELECT fqc.contract_id, fqc.times, fqc.cf_item, fqc.due_amount, fqc.due_date, fqc.received_amount, fqc.write_off_flag FROM ( SELECT fqc.times, fqc.contract_id FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc, fct_contract fct WHERE fqc.cf_item = 45 AND fqc.contract_id = fct.contract_id ) cf, fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fqc.contract_id = cf.contract_id AND cf.times = fqc.times AND fqc.cf_item != 45 ) cs LEFT JOIN fct_contract fct ON cs.contract_id = fct.contract_id LEFT JOIN hls_cashflow_item hci ON cs.cf_item = hci.cf_item
fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fct.company_id = #{companyId} AND fct.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, (SELECT p.approval_number FROM prj_project p WHERE p.project_id = cc.project_id) approval_number, cc.lease_start_date valid_from, (SELECT hdt.description FROM hls_document_type hdt, prj_project p WHERE hdt.business_type = p.business_type AND hdt.document_category = p.document_category AND hdt.document_type = p.document_type AND p.project_id = cc.project_id) AS document_type_desc, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) bp_name, (SELECT hbm.bp_id FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) bp_id, (SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = cc.unit_id) unit_name, (SELECT fe.name FROM fnd_employee fe WHERE fe.employee_id = cc.employee_id) employee_name, (SELECT fee.name FROM fnd_employee fee, prj_project p WHERE fee.employee_id = p.project_assistant AND p.project_id = cc.project_id) assist_name FROM con_contract cc where 1=1
AND cc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT fct.contract_id, fct.contract_name, fct.contract_number, fct.approval_number, fct.valid_from, ( SELECT DISTINCT hbt.description FROM hls_business_type hbt WHERE hbt.business_type = fp.business_type AND hbt.document_category = fp.document_category ) AS document_type_desc, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, fou.unit_name, fe.name employee_name, fee.name assist_name FROM fct_contract fct, fct_project fp, fct_project_bp fpb, hls_bp_master hbm, fnd_org_unit fou, fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee fee where fct.project_id = fp.project_id AND fp.project_id = fpb.project_id AND hbm.bp_id = fpb.bp_id AND fou.unit_id=fct.unit_id AND fe.employee_id=fct.employee_id AND fpb.credit_grantor_party='Y' AND fee.EMPLOYEE_ID=fp.project_assistant AND fct.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT distinct pfcc.CONTRACT_ID,pfcc.contract_type FROM plm_five_classify_con pfcc,( SELECT pfc.five_classification_id from plm_five_classification pfc WHERE pfc.five_classification_type = #{plmType} AND pfc.belongs_to_id = #{postLoanId}) pfcId where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfcId.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq='NORMAL'

SELECT distinct pfcc.CONTRACT_ID,pfcc.contract_type FROM plm_five_classify_con pfcc,( SELECT pfc.five_classification_id from plm_five_classification pfc WHERE pfc.five_classification_type = #{plmType} AND pfc.five_classification_id = #{postLoanId}) pfcId where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfcId.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq='NORMAL'

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_name,cc.creation_date FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME, fea.employee_id, fe.employee_code FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop, sys_user_allocation sua, sys_user su WHERE fea.employee_id = fe.employee_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id AND sua.user_id = su.USER_ID ) u, con_contract cc, act_assignee_node asn, prj_project prj
cc.project_id = prj.project_id AND asn.project_id = prj.ref_project_id AND asn.assignee_code = u.employee_code AND asn.project_document_category = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND asn.assignee_type = 'RISK'
AND cc.contract_id IN
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_name,fct.creation_date FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME, fea.employee_id, fe.employee_code FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop, sys_user_allocation sua, sys_user su WHERE fea.employee_id = fe.employee_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id AND sua.user_id = su.USER_ID ) u, fct_contract fct, act_assignee_node asn, fct_project fpj
fct.project_id = fpj.project_id AND asn.project_id = fpj.ref_project_id AND asn.assignee_code = u.employee_code AND asn.project_document_category = 'FCT_PROJECT' AND asn.assignee_type = 'RISK'
AND fct.contract_id IN
#{item}
